test_title: PYST 38: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between X and W when counted from the right of X. Only two people sit between W and M when counted from the right of W. Only three people sit between X and N when counted from the right of X. P sits to the immediate left of Y. Who sits third to the left of O?
solution:
**Given: **M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. Only two people sit between X and W when counted from the right of X.

2. Only two people sit between W and M when counted from the right of W.

3. Only three people sit between X and N when counted from the right of X.

4. P sits to the immediate left of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01d2bb89c295eb03473371fb13dda0d144c1ad6ce099d52dc6a16efae7082d19.png] 

O, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ca26e4f2ff88b9f572e12c1078f830e7c8aeb7b974d04376528d8544f2a9cd9.png] 

Thus, Y sits third to the left of O.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
